subject: Pricing discussion and monthly consumption bands — BrightSide AI
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia R&D <sofia@brightside.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:02:00-04:00
Subject: Pricing discussion and monthly consumption bands — BrightSide AI

Hi Sofia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align procurement and pricing with your forecast:

Summary from our call:
- Pilot: expected start 1–2 months, ~50–80M inference tokens/month (avg ~1.2k tokens/request).
- Production target (Q4): ramp to 250–350M tokens/month with higher burst peaks (~600M in peak days).
- Critical asks from your side: target unit economics ($/1M tokens) and procurement thresholds for PO/SOW.

Preliminary pricing context (for discussion, final numbers subject to model choice and commitment):
- Pilot band (50–100M/mo): indicative $70–90 per 1M tokens (pay-as-you-go or short commit).
- Production band (>=300M/mo committed): indicative $30–45 per 1M tokens (reserved capacity + volume discount).
- Factors that move price: reserved capacity length, quantization / smaller model variant, caching of prefixes, and batching profile.

Action items / next steps:
1) Can you confirm which monthly band you want us to price formally (Pilot vs Production)?
2) Please share procurement thresholds / approval limits (PO minimums, vendor evaluation triggers, RFx requirements). If you can loop in your procurement contact, we’ll send a one-page commercial summary they can use.
3) I attached a token-estimate worksheet (token-estimate-worksheet.csv) — if you fill the monthly usage rows we’ll lock in a tailored quote and draft a short SOW.

Attachments: token-estimate-worksheet.csv (worksheet to confirm per-feature token volumes), BrightSide_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW placeholder).

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute procurement + finance sync this week to walk the estimate and commerce options. Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0123

From: Sofia R&D <sofia@brightside.ai>

Cc: Anita Mehra <anita@brightside.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-10T16:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing discussion and monthly consumption bands — BrightSide AI

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side that will affect the band: 

1) Volumes: our immediate pilot will be ~60M tokens/month, but the product roadmap shows a likely ramp to 300–400M/month by late Q4 if latency and cost check out. We do have bursty traffic around product launches (short spikes up to ~700M tokens/day).

2) Procurement thresholds: Anita (cc’d) is our procurement lead. Current rules: PO > $25k requires formal vendor onboarding; spend > $100k requires additional security/IT evaluation and an approved SOW. Standard payment term preference is Net 30, but procurement can discuss Net 45 for enterprise deals. We do not always require 3 quotes if the vendor can provide SOC2 evidence and references.

3) Pricing ask: please send a short table showing the unit price at the Pilot band and at the Production band (committed). That will help our finance and product leads.

We’ll fill the token worksheet and return it by end of day tomorrow. Can you include an estimated monthly $ spend for both 60M and 300M cases? Thanks — Sofia

Best,
Sofia K.
Head of R&D | BrightSide AI
sofia@brightside.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia R&D <sofia@brightside.ai>
Cc: Anita Mehra <anita@brightside.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:35:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Pricing discussion and monthly consumption bands — BrightSide AI

Hi Sofia / Anita — appreciate the clarity on procurement thresholds. Below is a concise pricing table plus estimated monthly spend examples based on the bands we discussed. These are illustrative; we’ll produce a formal quote once we get the completed worksheet and a confirmed band.

Pricing & spend examples (indicative):
- Pilot band (50–100M/mo)
  - Unit price: $80 per 1M tokens
  - Example (60M/mo): 60 * $80 = $4,800/mo (~$57.6k/yr)

- Production band (>=300M/mo committed)
  - Unit price: $35 per 1M tokens (reserved capacity pricing with a 12-month commit)
  - Example (300M/mo): 300 * $35 = $10,500/mo (~$126k/yr)

Notes and levers:
- Reserved capacity and monthly commit materially lower the $/1M token. We can structure a blended ramp (higher $ in months 1–3 then step down once committed volumes are met).
- Technical levers (quantization, KV caching, prefix dedupe) can reduce tokens billed or effective cost per useful token — we’ll coordinate with your infra team on those optimizations during the pilot.
- SLA and enterprise add-ons (longer retention, audit logs, private deployment) are priced separately and typically trigger SOW-level procurement.

Next steps I propose:
1) You or Anita confirm the preferred band to price (Pilot vs Production).
2) Anita: can you confirm the vendor onboarding checklist and preferred PO threshold we should show on the commercial one-pager?
3) We’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement + finance sync (I’ve suggested windows in the attached updated worksheet).

I’ve attached an updated token-estimate-worksheet.csv with a pre-filled 60M and 300M example, plus a one-pager we can hand to procurement. If those estimates look in-line, I’ll follow with a commercial term sheet and draft SOW.

Thanks — Marcus

--

- Confirmed procurement rules from BrightSide: PO > $25k triggers vendor onboarding; spend > $100k requires SOW + security review. Payment term preference Net 30, potentially Net 45 for enterprise.
- From a commercial ops perspective we can accept PO-based billing for Pilot (<= $50k) under standard T&Cs. For deals that cross $100k/year we should push for a 12-month commit for pricing at the Production band.
- Action items for us:
  1) Prepare a one-page vendor onboarding packet (SOC2 summary, customer references, sample SOW). Rachel — can you pull the SOC2 summary and one-pager template?
  2) Finance: mark deal BRI-2026-042 as ‘requires SOW if annual >= $100k’. I’ll draft the SOW skeleton and hand to Marcus to share with Anita.
  3) Product/R&D enablement: schedule an infra sync to discuss caching/quantization opportunities during the pilot.

I’ll join the procurement call. Marcus — propose Thurs 07/15 10:00a PT / 1:00p ET and I’ll block it if that works.
